product.title: Cortech Summit All-Purpose Table - Molded Base with Laminate Top - Models 361, 363 & 364
product.body_html:
The Cortech Summit Large All Purpose Table pairs calming design with durable construction for behavioral health and other high-use secure environments. Because of its simple, residential feel, the large Summit table fits naturally in lounges, dayrooms, waiting areas, and patient spaces to support a therapeutic environment.

  • Molded polyethylene base with a durable high-pressure laminate top
  • Base is inherently antimicrobial and easy to clean
  • Options:
    • Model 361 - table with 42" round Plain Top
    • Model 361GT - table with 42" round Game Top
    • Model 363 - table with medium size Delta Top
    • Model 364 - table with large size Delta Top
    • Models 361S, 363S and 364S have a ballast door that secures with tamper-resistant screws and can be used to add sandbags on-site (loose sand not recommended)
    • Factory weighting available
  • Lifetime Warranty on base; 5-Year Warranty on top
  • Made in the USA to ISO Quality Standards
  • Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, Tide

The Summit all purpose table coordinates with other Summit seating and tables, allowing facilities to create cohesive, human-centered environments. Its cleanability, strength, and calming design make it a dependable choice for spaces that support healing and safety.

About Cortech Summit Furniture:
The Cortech Summit Series intense use furniture line is ideal for use as behavioral health furniture and Behavioral Healthcare mental health furniture. The Cortech Summit Furniture Series is also a perfect fit for residential institutions, public safety facilities and any intense or high abuse applications such as drug and alcohol rehabilitation centers and addiction treatment centers.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
